jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_cobblestone: Mine stone with a correct tool and no Silk Touch: 10% chance of a bonus alongside normal drops, +5% per Fortune level. Also drops itself when mined with a pickaxe.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_coal: Mine coal ore or deepslate coal ore with a correct tool and no Silk Touch: 10% chance of a bonus alongside normal drops, +5% per Fortune level. Burns like coal normally; in Fast Furnace, lasts 50% longer and boosts speed to 200%.
